name: Sexton Halloway, the Bell-Ringer
place: dungeon crypt_spiral SET B: floor 1's mini-boss (central vault, 30-34 m) — written to fit a 24 m room
_doc: Stream E (M2). A sexton who still rings for the dead, and the dead still come. Three sarcophagi stand open: every 'Wake the Dead' cast (interruptible) pulls hounds out of them. SEAL all three (use them like a brazier) and the rite is broken for good — the fight jumps to 'Sealed'. The bell rope by the north wall rings his own bell back at him once (stun). P2 'Sealed' at 50% (or as soon as the third seal goes on): a ring-shaped toll you dodge by standing close, and spread knells.
party: Solo: interrupt Wake the Dead and seal between casts — doable with a follower holding hounds. 2-3: one player seals while the others hold him. 5: trivial seals; the knell spread is the danger in a small room. M5 scaling: adds per Wake 2 -> 1 solo / 3 at five; knell radius down solo.

onUse.say: The great bell booms right over Halloway's head!

pull: Quiet, please. The service is for the departed.
Ah. Mourners. Or are you the departed? I lose track.
say.death: Halloway sits down on the steps, rope still in his hand. 'Who will ring for me?'
say.reset: Halloway goes back to polishing his bell.

enrage.say: ALL OF YOU, TO YOUR GRAVES. NOW.

knell.name: Knell
knell.say: The knell sounds for each of you — stand apart!

wake.name: Wake the Dead
wake.say: Halloway raises his hands over the coffins — stop him, or seal them!

onInterrupt.say: 'Rude,' says Halloway, losing his place in the rite.

actions.say: Something climbs out of an open sarcophagus!

grave_toll.name: Grave Toll
grave_toll.say: The toll rolls outward — step in close to him!

phases.name: Sealed
phases.say: My congregation! You have shut them in!

do.say: All three seals are on. The dead stay put — and Halloway is furious.
